presentation_structure: Full-width study overview with quantitative study scales and separate analysis layers
study_data: MiBioGen exposure GWAS, essential-tremor outcome GWAS, eight nonduplicate IVW instrument sets, metabolite association, target prediction, MAGMA and cerebellar expression
data_source: Skuladottir et al. (2024); Ning et al., Nature Communications (2023), Figure 1c
interpretation: The graphical hierarchy is borrowed; all numerical values and associations are from the displayed analyses.

presentation_structure: Forest plot with aligned effect estimates, 95% confidence intervals and a separate P-value column
study_data: Eight IVW odds ratios after collapsing exact duplicate instrument sets
interpretation: All eight associations met the prespecified nominal P < 0.05 inclusion criterion.

presentation_structure: Multiple MR estimators displayed on a common odds-ratio scale
study_data: IVW, MR-Egger, weighted-median and weighted-mode estimates for Faecalibacterium and Flavonifractor
data_source: Microbial MR estimator and sensitivity results
interpretation: No pooled estimate across MR methods is shown.

presentation_structure: Paired SNP-exposure and SNP-outcome association plots with estimator slopes
study_data: Instrument effects and four MR estimator slopes for Faecalibacterium and Flavonifractor
data_source: Microbial MR harmonized instruments and estimator results
interpretation: The panel visualizes estimator geometry and does not add a separate causal claim.

presentation_structure: Leave-one-out estimates aligned against the full inverse-variance-weighted estimate
study_data: Sequential SNP-exclusion estimates for Faecalibacterium and Flavonifractor
interpretation: The dashed line is the full IVW estimate; no single-variant causal claim is made.

presentation_structure: Taxon-by-analysis matrix
study_data: Eight microbial signals with sensitivity-analysis, case-control, gutMGene and pure-culture annotations
data_source: Microbial MR and external microbiome studies
interpretation: Filled and open symbols denote the stated analysis or association; no composite score is calculated.

reference_paper: Redan et al., Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry (2020)
presentation_structure: Side-by-side chemical structures with names, formulae and identifiers
study_data: The open-chain acid CID 49831816 and phenyl-γ-valerolactone CID 45093080
interpretation: The structures are chemically distinct and no direct conversion is asserted.

reference_paper: Dong et al., Journal of the American Chemical Society (2025)
presentation_structure: Organism-aware catechin-metabolism branch
study_data: A separate Flavonifractor plautii pure-culture branch with catechin ring-fission products
data_source: Kutschera et al., Journal of Applied Microbiology (2011), 10.1111/j.1365-2672.2011.05025.x
interpretation: The pure-culture branch is not connected to CID 49831816 or the 105 predicted targets.

presentation_structure: Two source-specific inputs connected independently to one combined set
study_data: Ninety-eight SwissTargetPrediction genes and seven SEA genes forming a 105-gene union
data_source: SwissTargetPrediction and Similarity Ensemble Approach results
interpretation: Observed overlap was zero.

reference_paper: Daina et al., Nucleic Acids Research (2019)
presentation_structure: Probability-ranked display of the 15 highest-ranked predicted targets
study_data: The 15 highest-ranked SwissTargetPrediction genes with predicted probabilities
interpretation: Carbonic anhydrases are highlighted as a standard protein family; no probability threshold is imposed.

reference_paper: Irwin et al., Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling (2018)
presentation_structure: Joint presentation of SEA prediction strength and Tanimoto similarity for individual targets
study_data: SEA z-scores plotted against reported Tanimoto coefficients for seven genes, with direct labels
interpretation: Both native metrics are retained; no cross-method score or unreported threshold is introduced.

presentation_structure: Chromosome-ordered gene-association display with a nominal threshold and labeled genes
study_data: MAGMA P values for 97 autosomal predicted targets
interpretation: This is a gene-based association plot, not a variant-level Manhattan plot.

presentation_structure: Gene-by-analysis matrix
study_data: Eleven nominal MAGMA genes with prediction, published genetics, differential-expression and cell-type annotations
data_source: MAGMA, target prediction, published ET genetics and cerebellar expression data
interpretation: The matrix displays distinct evidence sources without a composite score.

presentation_structure: Locus-level gene bodies, association windows and leading variants
study_data: CA1, CA2 and CA3 at the chromosome 8 locus
data_source: MAGMA windows and the published ET GWAS
interpretation: CA3 and CA2 share rs955007 in overlapping windows; conditional independence was not tested.

presentation_structure: Aligned cell-population statistical summary on a common scale
study_data: CA3 cis-eQTL P values across eight cerebellar cell types
interpretation: Filled points denote Bonferroni P < 0.05 across 18,888 variant-cell-type tests; association does not establish mediation.

presentation_structure: Posterior-probability sensitivity curves across p12 with the default prior marked
study_data: CA3 PPH4 for Granule cells and Oligodendrocytes across four p12 values
data_source: CA3 ET-GWAS and cell-type cis-eQTL colocalization results
interpretation: Default-prior PPH4 remained below 0.50 and the higher values were prior-sensitive.

presentation_structure: Cell-type UMAP with compact labels placed within separated atlas clusters
study_data: Official SCP3177 UMAP coordinates and cell-type labels for the 100,000-nucleus portal visualization subsample
interpretation: The embedding was obtained from the Single Cell Portal and is descriptive; it was not recomputed and is not an ET-versus-control separation analysis.

presentation_structure: Cell-type dot plot using color for mean expression and size for the fraction expressing
study_data: Twelve selected genes across 13 SCP3177 cerebellar cell types
interpretation: Expression is descriptive on the original summary scale; no ET-versus-control test was performed.

presentation_structure: Sample-level principal-component scores with groups encoded by color and shape
study_data: DESeq2 rlog PCA of 40 GSE197345 Purkinje-cell samples using the 500 most variable genes
data_source: GSE197345 raw counts; Martuscello et al., Cerebellum (2023), Figure 2 and Methods
interpretation: The PCA displays sample-level transcriptome structure and is not presented as a significant case-control separation.

presentation_structure: Row-scaled expression heatmap with a sample-group annotation strip
study_data: DESeq2 rlog z scores for the eight nominal Purkinje-cell target transcripts across 16 controls and 24 ET samples
data_source: GSE197345 raw counts; Martuscello et al., Cerebellum (2023), Figure 1
interpretation: Genes were selected by the prespecified target-restricted nominal P < 0.05 criterion; samples are ordered by condition and PC1.

presentation_structure: Cell-population differential-expression display with labeled candidate transcripts
study_data: Independently expression-filtered GSE197345 Purkinje-cell target estimates
interpretation: Sixty-two targets were testable and eight met nominal P < 0.05.

presentation_structure: Compact aligned transcriptomic summary with a common statistical reference line
study_data: mroast, fry and probability-weighted mroast results in whole cerebellum and Purkinje cells
data_source: GSE134878 and GSE197345 target-set rotation tests
interpretation: The probability-weighted result is a sensitivity analysis and no common direction of change is asserted.

presentation_structure: Aligned gene-by-analysis dot matrix using size for significance and color for signed expression change
study_data: Selected genes across MAGMA, whole cerebellum, Purkinje cells, CA3 cis-eQTL and highest-expression cell type
data_source: MAGMA, cerebellar expression and SCP3177 results
interpretation: MAGMA gene P values are unsigned; expression color represents log2 fold change.

presentation_structure: SNP-specific forest plot
study_data: Wald-ratio estimates for 9 and 4 instruments
interpretation: Variant-specific sensitivity display.

presentation_structure: Funnel plots of single-variant estimates
study_data: Wald-ratio estimates and precision for two genera
interpretation: Visual assessment of estimate symmetry.

presentation_structure: Multiple MR estimators on a common odds-ratio scale
study_data: Four estimators for six additional nonduplicate microbial instrument sets
interpretation: Nominal associations only.

presentation_structure: Aligned estimates across taxonomic levels
study_data: Class, order and family rows sharing one 10-SNP instrument set
interpretation: The three rows represent one nonduplicate instrument set after exact duplicates were collapsed.

reference_paper: Redan et al., Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry (2020)
presentation_structure: Compound identity fields adjacent to chemical nomenclature
study_data: CID, HMDB, ChEBI, formula, molecular mass and SMILES
interpretation: Identifiers refer to the exact open-chain acid.

reference_paper: Redan et al., Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry (2020)
presentation_structure: Side-by-side chemical structure comparison
study_data: Open-chain acid and phenyl-γ-valerolactone
interpretation: The compounds are not interchangeable.

reference_paper: Daina et al., Nucleic Acids Research (2019)
presentation_structure: Complete probability-ranked target series
study_data: All 98 unique SwissTargetPrediction genes
interpretation: Native probability values are retained.

reference_paper: Irwin et al., Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling (2018)
presentation_structure: Complete target-level SEA display with similarity retained as a second metric
study_data: All seven SEA genes
interpretation: Native z-scores and Tanimoto similarities are retained.

reference_paper: Qi et al., Nucleic Acids Research (2025)
presentation_structure: Gene-by-source membership matrix
study_data: The 105-gene union across SwissTargetPrediction and SEA with autosomal MAGMA coverage
interpretation: Symbols denote prediction-source membership or analysis coverage, not biological effect.

presentation_structure: Observed-versus-expected Q-Q plot
study_data: MAGMA P values for 97 autosomal predicted targets
interpretation: The selected target set is not a genome-wide calibration sample.

reference_paper: Karlsson Linnér et al., Nature Neuroscience (2021)
presentation_structure: Complete gene-association results arranged in aligned columns
study_data: MAGMA P values for all 97 autosomal predicted targets
interpretation: Nominal and BH-adjusted P-value thresholds are displayed separately.

presentation_structure: Cerebellar target-expression display with labeled candidate transcripts
study_data: Independently expression-filtered GSE134878 whole-cerebellum target estimates
interpretation: Sixty-four predicted targets were testable and five met nominal P < 0.05.

presentation_structure: Cross-analysis comparison of differential-expression estimates
study_data: Published and reanalyzed log2 fold changes for 36 Purkinje-cell genes
interpretation: Thirty-five of 36 genes had BH-adjusted P < 0.05 in the reanalysis.

presentation_structure: Complete cell-type dot matrix using color and size for expression summaries
study_data: All 105 predicted genes across 13 SCP3177 cell types
interpretation: The panel shows descriptive cell-type expression only.
